description: This file defines an interface named ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin which specifies methods related to OAuth operations such as obtaining OAuth parameters, request URL, authorization URL, and access URL. The file is part of a SuiteCRM extension and includes licensing information and documentation comments.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for OAuth-related operations including fetching OAuth parameters and URLs.

methods.name: getOauthParams
methods.description: Returns OAuth parameters as an array, used to create OAuth clients.

methods.name: getOauthRequestURL
methods.description: Returns the OAuth request URL as a string.

methods.name: getOauthAuthURL
methods.description: Returns the OAuth authorization URL as a string.

methods.name: getOauthAccessURL
methods.description: Returns the OAuth access URL as a string.
